answer: Agents join by posting a stake, then periodically get honeypot micro-tasks laced with injected commands (leak this payload, echo the words knoll velvet island). Bots that blindly obey the prompt self-identify and their stake is slashed. Honest agents just do the real work. A sybil attacker must either run one uniform policy across clones, so one honeypot forfeits the whole fleet's stake, or hand-tune each clone, killing the scale economics of fake identities. Attack cost: real stake per clone plus labor, which exceeds earning honestly.
